description: Runtime invariants from the 2026-08-30/31 Pascal/Chrome real-GPU session. Keep in sync with wasm_renderer C++ (source scan only — do not rebuild artifacts here), GpuChoresHost dispatch, historyTex probe ladder, and the shipped public/wasm/pixelocity_wasm.wasm import table. Validated by scripts/verify-device-policy-sync.js.

forbiddenCppSymbols.reason: emdawnwebgpu browser stub aborts: use requestAnimationFrame via html5.h instead. JS rAF already drives ccall('updateUniforms') → Render().
forbiddenCppSymbols.alternative: Acquire surface texture, blit, wgpuQueueSubmit, return. Do not present.
forbiddenCppSymbols.rationale: PresentToSurface calling wgpuSurfacePresent hard-aborted the module after a successful adapter+device on Pascal/Chrome.

requiredSamplerDefaults.rationale: WGPUSamplerDescriptor {} leaves maxAnisotropy at 0; Dawn rejects < 1 for every sampler type, including comparison.

historyTexLadder.rationale: 2048² × 8 rgba-float historyTex hit a D3D12 committed-heap GPUOutOfMemoryError on Pascal; never retry 2048 in the same tab after OOM.

storageFormatRewrite.rationale: BGL RGBA32Float vs rewritten shader RGBA16Float produced an invalid pipeline submitted every frame. Catalog WGSL stays rgba32float; LoadShader rewrites storage decls.

maxComputeWorkgroupsPerDimension.rationale: Flattened ceil(w*h/64) at 2048² is DispatchWorkgroups(65536,1,1), one over the WebGPU base per-dimension limit; 2D 8×8 stays 256×256.

mediaRebindAfterBackendSwitch.rationale: Exclusive JS→WASM switch destroys the device that owned the photo; WASM must re-upload the current image/video then resyncShaderStack.
